name: Laplace-1-Atlas

lineage.how_derived: causal-interventional decision model trained with the vendor's 'Decision Forge'; a smaller Laplace-1-Vector exists

purpose: Predict what an action will do inside an organization and use that to decide who does the work, who sees the information, what runs and what is accepted (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention dense transformer (Qwen3.8-27B layout)
architecture.attention: full attention every 4th layer, hidden 5120, head dim 256
